peak_days: Weekends (Saturday & Sunday) and Mondays (dedicated to Lord Shiva)
peak_seasons: Maha Shivaratri, Karthika Purnima, Shravana Masam, and Pushkaralu
average_wait_time: 20 to 30 minutes on weekdays (Tuesday–Friday), 45 to 60 minutes on weekends
peak_wait_time: 1 to 2 hours on Mondays; 3 to 4 hours during peak festival days
crowd_management_notes: Weekdays (Tuesday–Friday) have moderate crowds. Maximum congestion occurs during major festivals and holidays.
